spanish: Y amargaron sus vidas en servicio duro, en barro y en ladrillos y en todo servicio en el campo, todo su servicio que sirvieron en ellos en dureza.
grammarChanges: Semicolon → comma before 'todo su servicio': 'todo su servicio' is a second direct object of the same verb 'amargaron' (parallel to 'sus vidas', matching ואת כל עבדתם as a second accusative under one וימררו), not a new independent clause; a semicolon left it as a verbless fragment.

Left 'en ellos' (sourceTokenId h02001014016) unchanged: per freeze, the cited auditor warn on בָהֶם is not acted on, since resolving the suffix's referent would be an interpretive rewrite, not a grammar repair.

Left 'en dureza' for בְּפָרֶךְ unchanged: matches the rendering already used for the same lemma/morph in Éxodo 1:13; this is a style choice, not a cited mismatch, and changing it would create inconsistency rather than fix one.
